topic: Data duplication issue in session aggregation
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on identifying and resolving data duplication in the `device_session_agg_4` dataset. Initially, it was noted that a specific facility's footfall calculation (2+ on 7600) had been historically recalculated.

Later, [me] identified a bug where re-aggregation caused duplicate records for facilities assigned to clusters during the aggregation period. This issue resulted in inflated metrics, specifically doubling `session_number_predicted` and impressions, while frequency remained correct.

The root cause was traced to how data is aggregated when facilities are part of clusters over extended periods. A fix was implemented by [me], requiring a re-aggregation of all data points that involve clustering or long aggregation periods.
decisions: A fix was pushed to address the duplication issue in session aggregation.
Data involving cluster assignments and long aggregation periods must be re-aggregated.
action_items: Re-aggregate all data points that involve clustering or long aggregation periods.
